info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Reward Points Account Management API
info.description: The Reward Points Account Management API enables businesses to manage customer reward points effectively. This API supports operations such as updating reward point balances and modifying account details, enhancing customer loyalty initiatives. Typical users include customer service representatives and loyalty program managers who require efficient access to account management functionalities. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure that reward points are accurately tracked and updated, leading to improved customer satisfaction and engagement.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update details of the specified Reward Points Account, identified by its unique account ID. Make sure to include the necessary fields to apply the desired updates.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the reward points account associated with the specified Account ID (ACC-200045). The JSON payload must conform to the specified schema and contain the necessary fields for updating the account.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, and the reward points account has been updated.
